explanation: Derived consequence for erdosproblems.com/875 of the Erdős–Nicolas–Sárközy construction (A(x) ≫ x^{5−2√6}, per the abstract of [ENS91]): since 5−2√6 = 1/(5+2√6), the n-th element satisfies a_n ≪ n^{5+2√6}, so a_{n+1} − a_n ≤ a_{n+1} ≪ n^{5+2√6} and hence ≤ n^c eventually for any c > 5+2√6. The Lean statement: for c > 5+2√6 there is an infinite admissible A with gap A n ≤ n^c for all large n — i.e. such c belong to the answer set of erdos_875. The derivation is valid (the strict inequality on c absorbs the implied constant). Correct.
